ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Case__r.RecordType_DeveloperName__c == 'Loan_Application' && ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Sub_Status__c, 'Pending Callback') && ( ( ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c) && !ISBLANK(TEXT(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c)) && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c, 'Customer accepted to Proceed with application') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c, 'Follow Up Completed') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c, 'Contact Failed') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result__c, 'Customer Declined Offer') ) || ( ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c) && !ISBLANK(TEXT(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c)) && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c, 'Customer accepted to Proceed with application') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c, 'Follow Up Completed') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c, 'Contact Failed') && !ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Contact_Center_Result_sec__c, 'Customer Declined Offer') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Sub Status “Pending Callback”, the Contact Center Result can only be “Customer accepted to Proceed with application” or "Follow-up completed" or "Contact Failed" or "Customer Declined Offer". Please update your selection.
